review_candidates.title: Associate Technical Support Consultant
review_candidates.description: Overview Provides frontline technical support to clients via the telephone, email, chat, and monitoring alerts. Logs, triages, and resolves common, known issues at the first point of contact wherever possible, following standard operating procedures (SOPs) and knowledge base (KB) articles, and escalates unresolved or complex issues to the appropriate technical team within defined SLA timelines. Primary Objective: Log, troubleshoot, and resolve tickets at the first level wherever possible, escalating only when the issue requires advanced technical investigation. Responsibilities Receive client issues through phone, email, chat, or monitoring alerts and create tickets in ServiceNow (or the relevant ticketing tool) with accurate details, business impact, and priority. Investigate reported issues using standard operating procedures (SOPs), knowledge base (KB) articles, Windows utilities, and basic SQL queries. Identify and resolve common, known issues at the first point of contact wherever possible, minimizing ticket turnaround time. Record all investigation steps, actions taken, findings, and resolution details in the ticketing system. Categorize tickets, assess impact and urgency, assign the appropriate priority, and route or triage unresolved issues to the relevant technical team. Monitor ticket queues, identify pending or high-priority incidents, and ensure tickets are acknowledged and actioned within defined SLAs. Keep clients informed about ticket progress, immediate workarounds, resolutions, and escalations. Document outstanding tickets, actions taken, pending activities, and next steps for the incoming shift. Use company-approved AI tools (such as AI assistants and copilots) to help search knowledge base articles, summarize tickets, and draft client updates, while reviewing all output for accuracy and never entering PHI or confidential client data into unapproved tools. Qualifications Academic Requirements Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related discipline. Equivalent combination of education and relevant technical support experience may be considered. Experience 1 to 2 years of relevant experience in technical support, IT service desk/help desk, or a related technical domain. Working knowledge of ServiceNow or a relevant ticketing tool. Basic understanding of Windows operating systems. Basic SQL query skills. Good written and verbal communication, documentation, and customer service skills. Ability to prioritize tickets and resolve issues within SLA timelines. Ability to work effectively both independently and as part of a collaborative team. Good to have basic understanding of healthcare workflows and enterprise software support. Good to have basic exposure to HL7 or healthcare IT concepts. Basic AI Knowledge Basic understanding of what AI is, including generative AI and large language models (LLMs), and how AI assistants can support day-to-day technical support work. Familiarity with writing clear, specific prompts to get useful results, such as summarizing ticket history, drafting client communications, or finding relevant KB articles. Awareness that AI output can be inaccurate or incomplete, and the habit of validating AI-generated content against SOPs, KB articles, and system behavior before using it. Understanding of data privacy and security expectations when using AI tools, including never sharing PHI, credentials, or confidential client information with unapproved tools. Willingness to learn and adopt new AI-enabled tools and workflows as they are introduced. Travel / Shift Requirements Position requires working late evening and night shifts, as part of a 24/7 rotational shift pattern. Participation in after-hours, weekend, holiday, and on-call support rotations will be required to support critical client needs.
